Most stores go live in 7–10 days: free call on day 1, design on days 2–3, build on days 4–7, testing on days 8–9 and launch on day 10. Bigger catalogues or custom features can take a little longer, and I’ll tell you on the call.

WordPress websites start from $300, WooCommerce stores from $450, research peptide stores from $600, and landing pages or redesigns from $150. Apps are quoted per project. You get a fixed quote after the free call.

Yes. They include a COA page for every batch, an age gate, “research use only” notices, clear product specs and a payment setup suited to the niche.

Yes. I build mobile apps for iOS and Android and web apps, from calculators and booking tools to customer dashboards. If you started an app with an AI app builder and got stuck, I can fix it, finish it and help you launch it. Apps are quoted per project after a free call.

Yes. Our video team makes 2D explainer videos from $200, 3D animations from $300 and AI video editing from $100, usually delivered in about a week. Explainers work well for clinics, apps and stores that need to show how something works.

Yes. Our book formatter prepares Kindle, ebook and paperback files ready for KDP, and our WordPress & AI automation developer connects your forms, emails and tools so routine work runs on its own. Both are quoted per project after a free call.

WooCommerce gives you full ownership of your site and data, no platform fee per sale, full design freedom, and it works for niches some platforms restrict. Shopify is quick to start but adds monthly plan and app costs.

Product photos, product details (names, prices, variants, descriptions), an approved payment account, and your shipping and returns policy. Don’t have them all yet? We’ll plan around it on the call.

Yes. I have 65+ client reviews on Fiverr. You can order there, or book a free 30-minute call and work with me directly.

Yes. I work with brands worldwide, including the US and Europe. Calls run on Google Meet, Monday to Friday.
